newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia plans to auction 22 pct of Central Telegraph.
newsitem.headline: Russia plans to auction 22 pct of Central Telegraph.

text.p: Russia plans to hold an investment tender next month for 21.75 percent of the Central Telegraph communications concern, the Federal Property Fund said in its Reforma bulletin on Tuesday.

A stake of 48,188 shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles, will be offered at a starting price of 5.3 billion roubles ($963,000). The winner will also have to invest $61 million, including 20 percent of the total within a month.
The rest must be gradually invested by the end of 1999.
Bids will be accepted until 4 p.m. (1300 GMT) on December 23 and the results of the tender will be announced the next day, Reforma said.
The bulletin said the investment would be used to develop new data communication services and to renew Central Telegraph's network.
AOOT Tsentralny Telegraf is based on a company founded in Moscow in 1858. Its main business is document transmission.
Privatisation officials have said the state plans to hold a 38 percent stake until the end of 1998.
